answer.report_md:
### 判读
生成器需绘制四面板双轴复合图：每面板含10根柱、红色菱形及黄色三角点，并共用下方图例。左轴每10个百分点、右轴每2个百分点，所有数值均未直接标注，读取依赖刻度。每个值至少需要“收入组＋D1–D10＋系列”三项标签；45、22、19、11、28等在多个标记附近重复，具体归属存在视觉判读不确定性。页面没有数据表，这是最主要障碍。

heading.title: Share of women among wage employees in each decile of the hourly wage distribution and the decile-specific gender wage gap by country income group, latest available year

components.evidence: Each panel has “Female wage workers (%)” left and “Gender wage gap (%)” right axes.
Blue bars are overlaid with red diamond and yellow triangle point markers.
Lower-middle-income D10 markers fall below zero on the right axis.
One three-entry legend governs all four income-group panels.
Four repeated income-group charts form a two-by-two layout.
“Notes:” and “Source:” paragraphs appear beneath the legend.
The three-entry legend is centered below all four panels.
Panels are titled “Low-income countries”, “Lower-middle-income countries”, “Upper-middle-income countries”, and “High-income countries”.
The heading says “(percentage)”; both vertical axis titles also contain “(%)”.
“Deciles of the hourly wage distribution” is centered beneath every panel.
“Female wage workers (%)” and “Gender wage gap (%)” run vertically beside each panel.
All four plotting regions use a pale blue background rather than white.
Four panels each contain 10 bars and 20 point markers, totaling 120 marks.
